note: Passato prossimo with essere; andato agrees with the speaker (andata for a woman). The passato remoto andai is mostly written or southern.

gloss: I was going / I used to go
note: Imperfetto: ongoing or habitual past in one word. stavo andando stresses being mid-way, e.g. when something interrupted.
Trapassato prossimo: imperfetto of essere plus participle, used just like English had gone.
Irregular present vado. In speech io is usually dropped because the -o ending already says who.
stare + gerund is a real progressive, but optional: plain vado also works for right now.
Same form as the past simple: the passato prossimo covers both I went and I have gone.
Synthetic future: andr- + -ò. For plans, the present plus a time word (vado domani) is just as common in speech.
Grammatical, but starò + gerund mostly signals a guess (starà dormendo: he's probably asleep), not a future in progress.
Futuro anteriore is used, often after quando: quando sarò andato... It also marks guesses about the past: sarà andato.
